body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #5, company drawn at random (seed 20261202) from IT/software services + banks/NBFCs in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.6 (naive base rate 0.65) that: by 30-Jun-2027 the bank files that the NCLT-sanctioned scheme has become effective (or allots shares to UCL shareholders / cancels UCL's holding). Our reasoning: Regulatory NOCs (RBI, NSE/BSE) received and creditors/shareholders approved; management says 'next few months'; NCLT calendars slip. Naive base: [EST] NCLT second-motion petitions typically get sanction 3-12 months after filing; filed 05-Apr-2026, hearings 23-Jul, 22-Oct and 19-Nov-2026. Resolution: YES if by 30-Jun-2027 the bank files that the NCLT-sanctioned scheme has become effective (or allots shares to UCL shareholders / cancels UCL's holding). Source: NSE/BSE Reg-30 filings; NCLT Allahabad orders. Resolve by 2027-06-30; score with Brier vs the base rate.
